mapper.insert: INSERT INTO router_wallet_transaction ( user_id, business_id, transaction_type, balance_change_units, frozen_change_units, balance_after_units, frozen_after_units, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{businessId}, #{transactionType}, #{balanceChangeUnits}, #{frozenChangeUnits}, #{balanceAfterUnits}, #{frozenAfterUnits}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, business_id AS businessId, transaction_type AS transactionType, balance_change_units AS balanceChangeUnits, frozen_change_units AS frozenChangeUnits, balance_after_units AS balanceAfterUnits, frozen_after_units AS frozenAfterUnits, created_at AS createdAt FROM router_wallet_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND transaction_type = #{transactionType}
